Separate steady-detail-v1: small stationary two-state luma appearance, at least 6 transitions, bounded state/chroma errors and dwell. A reviewed hold is trimmed to matched cut points, at least 60 frames and four internal changes; first/last clip frames remain unchanged. Encoded selected/influence boundary RGB and selected-mean changes cannot worsen. Proposals are not semantic distraction labels.
